# Laksa -- equivalence evidence (step 4 of the migration protocol)

Collected 2026-08-09 with BOTH launchers present and the old one canonical, per AC-11.7. Every sealed comparison cites the seal path from its run's `verdict:` line, never a dereferenced `LATEST_*` (the two suffix families share those pointer names). Runs were strictly sequential -- the launchers share `_build` and `tmp/`.

## The examines table

| Gate            | Old (`bin/laksa`)                                          | New (`bin/devbin`)                                         | Verdict                       |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| test mix        | rc 0; `Result: 2540 passed (11 doctests, 2529 tests), 146 excluded`; seal `<stamp>.mix.errors` 0 bytes | rc 0; SAME Result line verbatim; seal `20260809-1608.MIX.errors` 0 bytes | IDENTICAL counts, both sealed |
| test credo      | rc 0; `Checking 781 source files`; `6320 mods/funs, found no issues.`; seal 0 bytes | rc 0; SAME two lines verbatim; seal `20260809-1608.CREDO.errors` 0 bytes | IDENTICAL examined set        |
| check codegen   | rc 0 (`mix ash.codegen --check`)                           | rc 0, sealed `20260809-1607.CODEGEN.errors` empty          | same command, same verdict    |
| check format    | rc 0 (`mix format --check-formatted`)                      | rc 0, sealed empty (catalogue-derived, elixir arm)         | same command, same verdict    |
| check deps      | rc 0 (`mix deps.unlock --check-unused`)                    | rc 0, sealed empty                                         | same command, same verdict    |
| check compile   | rc 0; MIX_ENV=test, --warnings-as-errors --force; 509 app files (this run also built the whole test-env dep tree first -- 289 compile stanzas, the day's first test-env build) | rc 0; same env and flags via `cmd/.lib/check-compile`; the SAME 509 app files force-recompiled on the now-warm deps; `_build/test` freshly written | same enforcement scope        |
| check toolchain | RED then GREEN -- see the pair below                       | RED then GREEN -- same facts both times                    | the AC-11.6 pair              |
| check critic    | rc 0; per-language empty-staging report (shell, elixir)    | rc 0; same per-language report, sealed empty               | same dispatch, same honesty   |
| test all        | rc 0, `all gates passed`                                   | rc 0, `all gates passed`                                   | both runners, one pass, both  |
| check all       | rc 0, PASS over six gates                                  | rc 0, PASS over the same six                               | same coverage                 |

**The toolchain pair (AC-11.6).** Before the Dockerfile bump, BOTH gates red with identical facts: image ARGs elixir 1.20.1 / OTP 28.1 against the 1.20.3 / 29.0.5 pins, both skew warnings naming both sides of each comparison (old run at the pre-bump working tree via a momentary inverse edit; new run sealed `20260809-1551.TOOLCHAIN.errors`). After the registry-verified bump (`hexpm/elixir:1.20.3-erlang-29.0.5-debian-bookworm-20260803-slim` + matching runner): old rc 0 with `done.`, new rc 0 with seal empty. Matching red, then matching green.

**check all order**: toolchain FIRST on both sides (the authored ruling, held by declaration order); the only slot difference is compile (3rd new, 5th old) -- coverage identical.

## Byte-identical probes

`diff` clean, old vs new: `version` (bare), `-v`, `version show` (identical BECAUSE the migration's first probe found devbin's show missing its trailing newline -- fixed in Devbin `c42055b` and re-vendored before this collection), `log --list`.

## Usage-path probes

| Probe                   | Old  | New  | Note                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ---- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| bare `test`             | rc 2 | rc 2 | Laksa's authored ruling, preserved by the handler shadow          |
| unknown command         | rc 2 | rc 2 | the contract predicted a 2->1 difference; there is NONE -- corrected in the AC and inventory |
| `db codegen` (no name)  | rc 1 | rc 1 | the bare-ash.codegen-hangs guard, both sides                      |
| bare `db`/`build`/`content`/`products` | help, rc 0 | help, rc 0 | authored topics on the new side              |
| `-h` on every handler   | topic, rc 0 | topic, rc 0 | new side re-enters `devbin help <cmd>`                       |

## Deliberate differences, each with an owner

1. **fmt surface** (D21, ruled pre-WP-10): bare `fmt` -> `fmt elixir` / `fmt all`; `fmt --check` retired into `check format` (same underlying command, proven above); `fmt --md` -> `fmt md`, still opt-in (`in_all: false` -- bare fmt never touched markdown and `fmt all` still does not).
2. **`test all` accepts the gate wrapper flags** (--purge/--purge-only/--allow-empty), fanned to both runners -- hv's fleet ruling 2026-08-09. The old refusal of everything else stands.
3. **Two zero-count promotions the old mix runner did not make** (a rc-0 run with no Result line printed "no tests ran" in red and EXITED 0; a trailer counting zero rendered green): both PROMOTED TO FAILED now, `--allow-empty` the escape. Issue-0006 doctrine; a strengthening, stated in the test topic.
4. **Shared options are consumed anywhere in `cli`'s argv** (old cli scoped them to pre-command after being bitten). Exposure probed: no laksa/arca task declares `--env`/`--repl`/`--iex` switches today. Documented in the cli topic.
5. **Seal suffix family**: `<stamp>.MIX.*` / `<stamp>.CREDO.*` (devbin's) vs the old lowercase `.mix`/`.credo`. The `LATEST_MIX` / `LATEST_CREDO` pointer NAMES are unchanged, so every machine reader keeps its address (`[ -s tmp/test/LATEST_MIX.errors ]` still works). The old lowercase runs become purge-invisible orphans at the switch -- hand-clean, per docs/migration.md step 5.
6. **Surface additions**: `version sync`/`version check` (nothing to do -- no sidecars), the sealed check verdicts under `tmp/check/`, and the Devbin group (doctor/upgrade/new/devbin).

## Not probed at depth, and why

Execution of `server`, `iex`, `repl`, `cli` (agent-banned surfaces here; dispatch and `-h` verified), `db proxy`/`db sql` (production access), `build release`/`deploy`/`assets`/`clean` (production or heavy; deploy stays HUMAN-RUN and its dispatch + topic are verified), `content sync`/`backsync` and `products money`/`validate` (mutating or remote; dispatch + usage guards verified), `fmt md` (tree-wide mutation), `precommit` (needs staged files -- note the hook still routes through the OLD launcher until the switch, and it ran green on every migration commit).

## Verdict

Every command the old launcher offered exists under the same name and dispatches. The four test/check gate pairs that measure the project measured IDENTICAL sets with identical verdicts; the one red that existed was red on both sides with the same facts and green on both after the ruled fix; four outputs are byte-identical. The deliberate differences are enumerated above, each with its reason. This is the evidence step 5 (the switch) is authorised over -- pending hv's explicit go.
